reasoning: Clauses 1-2 state the proposed training and demonstration in the indicative ('are trained', 'is demonstrated'), a modal misreading although the claim is labelled proposed. No cited item records either event. E7 and E3 are agent_proposed: they state only that the Right is conditional on outside training and that the condition needs demonstrating. E1 states that lineage crews carry channel repair under the Right from Book 20, not outside apprentices. The tested-condition relation holds only if the agent-proposed condition does.
quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.
alternative_reading: Conditional reading: if outside apprentices were trained under the Special Draw Right and their repair demonstrated, the condition the Right carries would be tested. No quote was offered (quote_offered is null). E7 carries only the agent-proposed condition, and no cited item states that training occurred.
would_settle: A cited item not marked agent_proposed that states outside apprentices were trained under the Right and their repair was demonstrated. Without it, the claim stays a conditional proposal.
creative_room: The stage can still ask what the lineage would have to carry and what it would mean for the labour. Outside training and demonstrated repair remain available as proposals if written conditionally ('if', 'would'). The Right's condition and its Book 24 review point must be treated as proposals, not record.

clauses.text: Outside apprentices are trained under the Special Draw Right
clauses.note: No cited item records outside training occurring. E7 (agent_proposed) states only that the Right is conditional on such training.
E3 (agent_proposed) says the condition needs demonstrating. No cited item records a demonstration.

clauses.text: so the condition the Right carries is tested
clauses.note: Holds only if the agent-proposed condition in E7 holds. The relation follows from that premise, not from the record.

defensible_possibility: A proposed Book stage in which the Right's agent-proposed condition is tested: if outside apprentices were trained under it and their repair demonstrated, the lineage's maintenance role would be tested. Presented as proposal, not record.
